description: Control-systems primitives: actuator wrappers (rate-limit, saturation), feedback / delay (Z^-N) for breaking cyclic graphs into DAGs, fail-safe latches. Hosts nodes previously published under Physics.Control:*.

subPlugins.description: Actuator-side primitives. Setpoint wraps a controller output with rate-limit (slew) and saturation so the rest of the plant model never sees a non-physical command.
Cycle-breaking primitives. Feedback channel = unit-delay (Z^-N) that lets closed-loop control graphs (motor + PI + tachymeter) stay topologically DAG-valid.
Fail-safe / interlock primitives. Emergency Shutdown is a latched safety bit: trips on any trigger=true, stays latched until an operator-initiated reset.

Simulation-infrastructure primitives. RK4 Solver is the Cash-Karp adaptive integrator (F3); it lives as a config carrier in the scene wiring and is attached to whichever Sim.Graph references its enclosing SceneItem. Future Rosenbrock4 / SUNDIALS solvers will register here.

Fractal container that wraps an inner RuntimeGraph + Session via IGraphNodeState. Binds to a SceneItem via sceneItemId (set automatically by the editor's config-link), attaches the scene's solvers to its inner session, and sub-steps the inner at K = round(innerHz / parentHz) per parent fire. Lazy-stores its inner graph as serialized JSON on item.data.subGraphJson; the editor's drill-down (double-click) and breadcrumb (Esc / Ctrl+↑) navigate in and out without keeping multiple canvases live at once.
